# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [The US proposes new tariffs of 15% to 35% on China, the EU, India and 11 other economies.](https://fiopoin.com/): Thursday, November 26, 2026. The US Trade Representative proposed new Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies on November 25, with top rates of 35% for Vietnam, 25% for India, 20% for China and 15% for the EU and Japan. Comments are due January 5 and hearings start January 25.
- [Stocks and your savings: Wall Street erases a 1,100 point Dow drop, and Asia rebounds on Thursday.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Trade and tariffs: The US proposes tariffs of 15% to 35% on 14 economies, including China, the EU and India.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [The Fed and your loans: US core inflation hits 3.3% as Korea raises rates and a Fed hike looks near certain.](https://fiopoin.com/#rates)
- [Oil and the Gulf: Yemen's Houthis say they struck Saudi Arabia's largest refinery at Ras Tanura.](https://fiopoin.com/#energy)
